rules.name: Autonomy Protocols
rules.description: Select 1 friendly LIGHT CORE unit. That unit may activate immediately, ignoring normal activation order. If that unit has already fully activated this turn, it may instead perform 1 additional action.

rules.name: Localized Shield Bloom
rules.description: Select 1 HEAVY SUPPORT or LIGHT SUPPORT unit. Until the end of the turn, when that unit is targeted by an attack, you may choose 1 other friendly LIGHT or HEAVY CORE unit within CMD range. That unit becomes the target of the attack instead. A unit may only redirect 1 attack this way per turn.

rules.name: Unified Response Protocol
rules.description: When an enemy unit declares an attack or movement within your Command (CMD) range, you may select 1 friendly ship within CMD range of that enemy unit. Place a Reaction Token on the selected ship.

rules.name: Fleet Council Resolution
rules.description: Select 1 friendly LIGHT SUPPORT unit. When that unit activates, you may select 1 other friendly LIGHT SUPPORT unit within Command (CMD) range. That second unit may immediately perform 1 additional Move Action, even if it has already activated this turn.

rules.name: •••Helix Line Formation Maneuver
rules.description:
Select up to 3 friendly units within Command (CMD) range of your FLAGSHIP. Immediately perform the following in sequence. Each selected unit may perform 1 Move Action.
Each unit must end this movement within CMD range of at least one other selected unit.
After all movements are complete: Each selected unit may immediately perform 1 Attack Action, resolving in any order. These actions are treated as part of each unit’s normal actions for the turn.

rules.name: •••Fanning Doctrine
rules.description: Select up to 3 friendly units within Command (CMD) range. Until the end of the turn when one of these units completes its activation, you may immediately select another selected unit that has not yet activated. That unit may activate next, ignoring normal activation order.
